description: This file defines the StatelessWorkerDirector class, which implements the IPlacementDirector interface to determine placement of stateless worker silos in Orleans runtime. It contains logic to assign activations to compatible silos, preferring local silo placement if possible.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerDirector
classes.description: Implements placement logic for stateless worker silos in Orleans runtime.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the silo to activate a new grain, preferring local silo if compatible and not terminating.
